verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog shows that teams can create documents from their home page, attach existing documents from projects and issues, and group resources into sections (linear-docs-22). Documents can also be created and edited on mobile (linear-docs-71), support rich callouts (linear-docs-98), and can be kept current by Loops tied to project changes, with author indicators showing who wrote what (linear-docs-34, linear-docs-96). This positions docs and PRDs right alongside project work (linear-docs-76). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the docs feature (folders, permissions and sharing controls, standalone notes), and independent or hands-on corroboration from community users.
